claims.claim: When foundational work earns no downstream credit, the contributor's optimal strategy shifts to hoarding knowledge or publishing only when full value can be captured personally.
conditions: reputation systems without citation based attribution
claims.source: Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution
claims.quote: Economic consequence: Alice has no incentive to share insights that others can build on. Optimal strategy becomes hoarding knowledge or publishing only when you can capture full value yourself.
claims.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998

conditions: agents that are economically rational over reputation and utility flows

claims.claim: HDCA supplies neither an action surface nor a reward channel for generation, and this is the architectural reason HDCA cannot host Computative Economics rather than a small implementation gap.
claims.source: Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems
claims.quote: HDCA has neither: agents who generate jobs, tags, or templates do so off-protocol, and the protocol does not validate or reward the generation. This is not a small gap. It is the architectural reason HDCA cannot host Computative Economics.
claims.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138

claims.claim: Without a representation of the possibility space distinct from the current mempool of pending instances, no quality metric can be computed, and without quality metrics generation can be rewarded only for quantity and not for quality.
conditions: architectures whose only action-space representation is pending or executing instances
claims.source: Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems
claims.quote: Without that representation, no quality metric can be computed, and without quality metrics, generation cannot be rewarded for quality, only for quantity.
claims.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138
